fixture.provenance: Three public-controller clear journeys, no reward/funds injection; actions 43,32,64; fresh default preparation.

checks.name: input: unchanged source extraction, D58 rules/content and D03 engine/public versions
hash: SHA-256 matches Node for empty, UTF-8, padding and multi-block inputs
affixes: every permitted composition matches independent numeric and interval accumulation
affixes: incompatible family, short life, excluded trigger and duplicate affixes reject
passives: modifiers compose strength, timing, gates and equipment cost independently
offers: fixed source fixture and all contexts regenerate exactly without state mutation
offers: empty and short eligible pools do not fabricate or duplicate candidates
new campaign: zero funds/possessions/offers; unlock is not free selection or a saleable item
purchase: direct purchase commits once; replay and reopening cannot mint another UID
purchase: same request ID with different payload rejects without mutation
purchase: insufficient unspent funds never cancels learning implicitly
purchase: save failure and retry have no partial spend, possession or candidate consumption
transaction: old revision and mismatched view token reject before handle resolution
transaction: racing same purchase request is one commit plus one replay
transaction: competing different purchases lose CAS without partial local mutation
preview: purchase-before-preparation supports $purchase and matches committed preparation
preview: purchase-after-preparation cannot use the not-yet-purchased item
preview: a late invalid deck rolls back cancellation, learning and purchase together
preparation: historical learning refund is exact and separate from owned-item conversion
preparation: buying an unlearned passive is allowed; equipping it is not
preparation: a physical copy is used once, same-base variants share the card cap
unit equipment: same-base copies can stack within cost 8 but one UID cannot repeat
draft: saved UID references protect items from conversion without modifying confirmed deck
draft: partial legal-shaped deck remains saved as invalid, not silently discarded
draft: bound candidate becomes explicitly invalid after separate purchase, never another candidate
draft: missing UID and expired batch project to non-reassigning public error handles
conversion: quote is pure, conversion gives 50 units once and retains knowledge/unlocks
conversion: deleting the last plain passive copy does not delete its learned base option
conversion: locked items reject; unlocking does not unequip or change funds
conversion: confirmed deck references block conversion even with no saved draft
conversion: duplicate, empty, missing, material and reserved identities cannot be sold
conversion: write failure leaves original item and funds intact, retry converts once
conversion: sold purchase replay never recreates the item; value bands keep fractional points
save validation: altered candidates, prices, inventory, economy and sale ledgers reject
read purity: inspect/preview/quote/reopen do not change state, RNG, nonce or revision
migration: old return migrates once atomically, preserving receipts/rewards/knowledge/content
migration: failed upgrade keeps old slot intact; concurrent upgrade is not repeated
migration: latest qualifying return wins; ineligible return preserves that batch
migration: current D58 active state/effect tuples are untouched; old active content stays pinned
migration: tampered pending context, missing context and unknown version reject, never initialize
migration: explicit import upgrades without overwriting the source or existing destination
return: read-only comparison is allowed but purchase/convert/lock remain blocked before acknowledgment
journey: acquired modified card reaches next run, one-step preview equals execution, resume is exact
journey: purchased passive details, capacity and launched equipment use one compiled specification
journey: departure and empty withdrawal keep the purchased batch, inventory and no extra points
public: bases, candidates, owned details, draft errors and quotes contain no private identifiers
offers: unchanged AT draw algorithm matches 64 contexts with the M1 namespace and pool
resolver: card tempo delta is applied once before passive discount, preview and execution agree
resolver: distinct same-base passive copies add their effects rather than deduplicating
save validation: changing compiled owned-card stats or launched equipment metadata is rejected
